NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IRLY centres the map on where you are when you tap “My location”. Your position stays on your phone and is never shared with other members.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IRLY uses the photos you choose for your profile picture, your activities and the moments you post live.
NSMotionUsageDescription: IRLY uses motion to add a subtle depth effect to destination cards.
NSCameraUsageDescription: IRLY uses the camera when you take your profile photo or a photo to share.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: IRLY adds the activities you choose to your calendar, only when you tap “Add to my calendar”. IRLY never reads your calendar.
NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: IRLY adds the activities you choose to your calendar, only when you tap “Add to my calendar”. IRLY never reads your calendar.
